```{r switches}
DATA_FILE    <- Sys.getenv("PMX_DATA", "")            # "" = discover the single csv in this directory
STUDY_ID     <- ""            # "" = read STUDYID off the table
DRUG         <- "drug"
INDICATION   <- ""            # "" = not stated in the table
MATRIX       <- ""            # "" = not stated in the table
LAB          <- ""            # "" = not stated in the table
ANALYTE_NAME <- ""            # "" = the PCTEST analyte with the most records
AUTHOR       <- "PMX Agent"
OUT_DIR      <- Sys.getenv("PMX_OUTPUT_DIR", "output")
QT_CHANGE_SOURCE <- "auto"
CONC_UNIT    <- ""            # Unit of PKCONC in the input, e.g. ng/mL; do not enter the analyte name.
HYSTERESIS_VIEW <- "individual" # "individual" for patient panels; "overview" for dose-group overlay.
HYSTERESIS_PANELS <- 12L       # Maximum patient panels per figure.
PAIRING_METHOD <- ""          # Source PK/ECG matching rule, e.g. same visit and nominal time.
BASELINE_DEFINITION <- ""     # Source baseline rule, e.g. mean of predose QTcF.

cq_note <- function(...) cat(..., file = stderr())

# Categorical reference levels
mode_level <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x); x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return(NA_character_)
  names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[[1]]
}

cat_counts <- function(d, v) {
  if("USUBJID" %in% names(d)) d <- d[!duplicated(d$USUBJID),,drop=FALSE]
  lv <- as.character(d[[v]]); lv <- lv[!is.na(lv)]
  if (!length(lv))
    return(data.frame(level = character(0), N = integer(0), rank = integer(0),
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  tb <- sort(table(lv), decreasing = TRUE)
  data.frame(level = names(tb), N = as.integer(tb), rank = seq_along(tb),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# Fitted reference level
cat_ref_level <- function(d, v, fit = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(fit)) {
    mf <- tryCatch(stats::model.frame(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(mf) && v %in% names(mf) && is.factor(mf[[v]])) return(levels(mf[[v]])[1])
  }
  x <- d[[v]]
  lv <- if (is.factor(x)) levels(x) else levels(factor(as.character(x)))
  if (length(lv)) lv[1] else NA_character_
}

# Coefficient level
cat_level_of_term <- function(d, v, term) {
  x <- d[[v]]
  lvls <- if (is.factor(x)) levels(x) else levels(factor(as.character(x)))
  cand <- lvls[vapply(lvls, function(l) identical(paste0(v, l), as.character(term)),
                      logical(1))]
  if (length(cand)) return(cand[which.max(nchar(cand))])
  sub(paste0("^", v), "", as.character(term))
}

# "<level> : <reference> (N = n : n_ref)" - the numbers are read off the data frame.
cat_effect_label <- function(d, v, level, ref = NULL, fit = NULL) {
  if(!is.null(fit)) {
    mf <- model.frame(fit)
    if(!"USUBJID" %in% names(mf) && "USUBJID" %in% names(d)) {
      fitted_rows <- match(rownames(mf),rownames(d))
      if(anyNA(fitted_rows)) stop("Cannot align categorical comparison counts to fitted records")
      mf$USUBJID <- d$USUBJID[fitted_rows]
    }
    d <- mf
  }
  cc <- cat_counts(d, v)
  if (is.null(ref)) ref <- cat_ref_level(d, v, fit)
  n_of <- function(l) {
    i <- which(cc$level == as.character(l))
    if (length(i)) cc$N[i[1]] else NA_integer_
  }
  sprintf("%s : %s (N = %d : %d)", cat_level_display(v, level), cat_level_display(v, ref),
          n_of(level), n_of(ref))
}

# Factor reference levels
set_cat_ref <- function(d, vars, ref = NULL) {
  releveled <- character(0)
  want_for <- function(v) {
    r <- if (is.null(ref)) cov_ref else ref
    if (is.null(r) || !length(r)) return("modal")
    if (length(r) == 1 && (is.null(names(r)) || !nzchar(names(r)[1]))) return(as.character(r)[1])
    if (v %in% names(r)) return(as.character(r[[v]]))
    "modal"
  }
  for (v in intersect(vars, names(d))) {
    x <- d[[v]]
    if(!v %in% cov_categorical) next
    f <- factor(as.character(x))
    if (nlevels(f) < 2) { d[[v]] <- f; next }
    want <- want_for(v)
    top <- if (identical(want, "modal")) mode_level(if("USUBJID" %in% names(d)) d[[v]][!duplicated(d$USUBJID)] else f) else {
      if (want %in% levels(f)) want else {
        cq_note("CQTC_SCHEMA_REF_UNKNOWN ", v, ": cov_ref level '", want,
                "' is not in the data - using the most frequent level\n")
        mode_level(f)
      }
    }
    if (!is.na(top)) {
      if (levels(f)[1] != top) releveled[v] <- levels(f)[1]
      f <- stats::relevel(f, ref = top)
    }
    d[[v]] <- f
  }
  list(data = d, releveled = releveled)
}

check_cat_ref <- function(d, vars, fit = NULL) {
  if(!is.null(fit)) d <- model.frame(fit)
  for (v in intersect(vars, names(d))) {
    rx <- d[[v]]
    if(!v %in% cov_categorical) next
    cc <- cat_counts(d, v)
    if (!nrow(cc)) next
    rr <- cat_ref_level(d, v, fit)
    if (!is.na(rr) && !identical(as.character(rr), as.character(cc$level[1])))
      message("CQTC_SCHEMA_REF_NOT_LARGEST ", v, ": model reference '", rr,
              "' is not the most frequent level '", cc$level[1],
              "' - re-check the labels for this covariate")
  }
}

# Categorical comparison labels
add_cat_labels <- function(tab, vars, d, fit = NULL) {
  lv <- rownames(tab)
  if (is.null(lv)) return(tab)
  lab <- vapply(lv, function(t) {
    hit <- vars[vapply(vars, function(v) startsWith(as.character(t), v), logical(1))]
    if (!length(hit)) return(NA_character_)
    v <- hit[which.max(nchar(hit))]
    x <- d[[v]]
    if(!v %in% cov_categorical)
      return(sprintf("%s (continuous)", cov_display(v)))
    cat_effect_label(d, v, cat_level_of_term(d, v, t), fit = fit)
  }, character(1))
  if (any(!is.na(lab))) tab[["Comparison (N)"]] <- lab
  tab
}

# Random-effects structure
CQTC_RE_LADDER <- c("(PKCONC | USUBJID)", "(1 | USUBJID)")

cq_conv_msg <- function(fit) {
  if (!inherits(fit, "merMod")) return(NULL)
  msg <- fit@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
  if (is.null(msg)) NULL else gsub("\n", " ", paste(msg, collapse = "; "))
}

# A warning-bearing/singular candidate is not eligible for BIC or a reported final slope.
fit_valid <- function(fit) {
  if(is.null(fit)) return(FALSE)
  if(!inherits(fit,"merMod")) return(all(is.finite(stats::coef(fit))) && all(is.finite(stats::vcov(fit))))
  code <- fit@optinfo$conv$opt
  clean_code <- !is.numeric(code) || all(is.finite(code) & code==0)
  notes <- c(cq_conv_msg(fit),attr(fit,"pmx_fit_warnings"))
  bad <- any(grepl("failed to converge|degenerate.*Hessian|unable to evaluate.*gradient|nearly unidentifiable|negative eigenvalue",notes,ignore.case=TRUE))
  clean_code && !bad && is.null(cq_conv_msg(fit)) && !lme4::isSingular(fit) &&
    all(is.finite(lme4::fixef(fit))) && all(is.finite(as.matrix(stats::vcov(fit))))
}
cq_is_clean <- function(fit) fit_valid(fit)

cq_fit_at <- function(re, fixed_rhs, data) {
  rhs <- if (identical(re, "none")) fixed_rhs else paste(fixed_rhs, "+", re)
  warnings <- character()
  fit <- tryCatch(withCallingHandlers(
    if (identical(re, "none"))
      stats::lm(stats::as.formula(paste("CFBQTCF ~", rhs)), data = data)
    else lme4::lmer(stats::as.formula(paste("CFBQTCF ~", rhs)), REML = FALSE, data = data),
    warning=function(w) {warnings <<- c(warnings,conditionMessage(w));invokeRestart("muffleWarning")}),
    error = function(e) {cq_note("CQTC_FIT_ERROR ",re," on ",fixed_rhs,": ",conditionMessage(e),"\n");NULL})
  if(!is.null(fit)) attr(fit,"pmx_fit_warnings") <- warnings
  fit
}

cq_choose_re <- function(fixed_rhs, data) {
  for (re in CQTC_RE_LADDER) {
    fit <- cq_fit_at(re, fixed_rhs, data)
    if (cq_is_clean(fit)) return(list(fit = fit, re = re))
    if (!is.null(fit)) {
      reason <- if (lme4::isSingular(fit)) "singular" else {
        m <- cq_conv_msg(fit); if (is.null(m)) "invalid" else m }
      cq_note("CQTC_RE_UNUSABLE ", re, " on ", fixed_rhs, ": ", reason, "\n")
    }
  }
  cq_note("CQTC_RE_NONE lmer unusable for this dataset; reporting fixed effects only\n")
  list(fit = cq_fit_at("none", fixed_rhs, data), re = "none")
}

# Refit with the selected structure
cq_fit <- function(fixed_rhs, data, re = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(re)) {
    fit <- cq_fit_at(re, fixed_rhs, data)
    if (fit_valid(fit)) {
      msg <- cq_conv_msg(fit)
      if (!is.null(msg)) cq_note("CQTC_CONVERGENCE_WARNING ", re, ": ", msg, "\n")
      attr(fit, "re_struct") <- re
      return(fit)
    }
    cq_note("CQTC_RE_UNUSABLE_ON_SUBSET ", re, "; refitting this subset on the ladder\n")
  }
  chosen <- cq_choose_re(fixed_rhs, data)
  fit <- chosen$fit
  if(!fit_valid(fit)) stop("CQTC_FIT_UNUSABLE: no clean fit on the existing random-effects ladder")
  attr(fit, "re_struct") <- chosen$re
  fit
}
```

```{r covariate-config}
# Display name of a covariate (cov_label map; unlisted covariates keep their name).
cov_display <- function(v) {
  v <- as.character(v)
  hit <- match(v, names(cov_label))
  ifelse(is.na(hit), v, as.character(cov_label[hit]))
}
# The printed name of a categorical level (cov_levels map; unlisted levels as-is).
cat_level_display <- function(v, l) {
  m <- cov_levels[[v]]
  l <- as.character(l)
  hit <- match(l, names(m))
  ifelse(is.na(hit), l, as.character(m[hit]))
}

cq_format_coef <- function(x) vapply(x,function(value) {
  if(!is.finite(value)) return("NE")
  a <- abs(value); if(a==0) return("0")
  if(a<0.0001) return(sub("e([+-])0+","e\\1",formatC(value,digits=1,format="e")))
  places <- if(a>=1) 2 else max(2,1-floor(log10(a)))
  sub("\\.$","",sub("0+$","",formatC(value,digits=places,format="f")))
},"",USE.NAMES=FALSE)

cq_kable <- function(d,...) {
  shown <- d; prefixes <- attr(d,"bold_labels")
  shown[] <- lapply(shown,function(x) {x <- as.character(x);x[is.na(x)] <- "";htmltools::htmlEscape(x)})
  column <- intersect(c("Covariate","Variables","Characteristic"),names(d))[1]
  if(!is.na(column)) for(i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {
    label <- as.character(d[[column]][i])
    if(startsWith(label,"\u00a0")) shown[[column]][i] <- paste0(
      '<span data-indent="1" style="padding-left:1ch">',htmltools::htmlEscape(sub("^\u00a0","",label)),'</span>')
    else if(length(prefixes) && !is.na(prefixes[i]) && nzchar(prefixes[i]) && startsWith(label,prefixes[i]))
      shown[[column]][i] <- paste0("<strong>",htmltools::htmlEscape(prefixes[i]),"</strong>",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(substring(label,nchar(prefixes[i])+1)))
  }
  knitr::kable(shown,format="html",escape=FALSE,row.names=FALSE,...)
}
```

```{r read-data}
cq_files <- list.files(".", pattern = "[.]csv$")
cq_files <- cq_files[!grepl("^(tbl_|html_tbl_|covariates[.]csv$|labels[.]csv$|endpoints[.]csv$|safety_endpoints[.]csv$|nca_initials[.]csv$|ladder_table[.]csv$)", cq_files)]
if (nzchar(DATA_FILE)) {
  if (!file.exists(DATA_FILE)) stop("CQTC_SCHEMA_NO_DATA DATA_FILE not found: ", DATA_FILE)
  cq_file <- DATA_FILE
} else if (length(cq_files) == 1) {
  cq_file <- cq_files[1]
} else if (length(cq_files) == 0) {
  stop("CQTC_SCHEMA_NO_DATA no csv in ", getwd(),
       " — put the study's QTc/PK export there, or set DATA_FILE")
} else {
  ok <- vapply(cq_files, function(f) {
    h <- toupper(names(utils::read.csv(f, nrows = 0)))
    any(h %in% c("PKCONC", "CONC", "CONCENTRATION", "PK_AVAL")) &&
      any(h %in% c("CFBQTCF", "CFBQTC", "DELTAQTCF", "QTCFAG", "QTCF"))
  }, logical(1))
  if (sum(ok) == 1) cq_file <- cq_files[ok] else
    stop("CQTC_SCHEMA_MULTI cannot tell which csv is the analysis dataset in ", getwd(),
         " (found: ", paste(cq_files, collapse = ", "),
         "); set DATA_FILE or pass --data <file>")
}

.cq_alias <- function(cands, canon, required = FALSE) {
  hit <- cands[cands %in% names(qtc_df)]
  if (!length(hit)) {
    if (required) stop("CQTC_SCHEMA_NO_CORE the table has none of ",
                       paste(cands, collapse = " / "), " — it is not a c-QTc table")
    return(invisible(FALSE))
  }
  if (hit[1] != canon) {
    names(qtc_df)[names(qtc_df) == hit[1]] <<- canon
    cq_note("CQTC_SCHEMA_ALIAS", hit[1], "->", canon, "\n")
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

stat_func <- function(df, var, stat) {

  df %>%
    distinct(USUBJID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    summarize(
      stat = do.call(
        stat,
        list({{ var }}, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    ) %>%
    pull(stat) %>%
    as.numeric()
}

dose_of <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  out <- sub("^.*?([0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*[[:space:]]*(mg/kg|mg/m2|mg|µg/kg|ug/kg|µg|ug|g))\\b.*$",
             "\\1", x)
  out[!grepl("[0-9]", out)] <- x[!grepl("[0-9]", out)]
  trimws(out)
}
regimen_of <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  out <- sub("^.*[[:space:]]([^[:space:]]+)[[:space:]]*$", "\\1", x)
  out[is.na(x) | !nzchar(out)] <- "single regimen"
  out
}
cycle_of <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  m <- regmatches(x, regexpr("CYCLE[[:space:]]*[0-9]+|C[0-9]+\\b", x, ignore.case = TRUE))
  out <- toupper(trimws(substr(x, 1, 7)))
  hit <- nzchar(m)
  out[hit] <- toupper(m[hit])
  out[is.na(x)] <- NA_character_
  out
}

qt_numeric <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
qt_derived <- qt_numeric(qtc_df$QTCFAG) - qt_numeric(qtc_df$BQTCF)
qt_supplied <- qt_numeric(qtc_df$CFBQTCF)
qt_paired <- is.finite(qt_derived)
if (QT_CHANGE_SOURCE == "auto")
  QT_CHANGE_SOURCE <- if (any(qt_paired)) "derived" else "supplied"
if (QT_CHANGE_SOURCE == "supplied" && !any(is.finite(qt_supplied)))
  stop("CQTC_QT_CHANGE_SUPPLIED requires usable change-from-baseline QTcF values")
cq_note("CQTC_QT_CHANGE_SOURCE ", QT_CHANGE_SOURCE, "\n")
qt_disagreement <- qt_paired & is.finite(qt_supplied) & abs(qt_supplied - qt_derived) > 0.11
qt_change_qc <- list(source=QT_CHANGE_SOURCE, paired_records=sum(qt_paired),
                     discrepancies=sum(qt_disagreement), tolerance_ms=0.11)
if (any(qt_disagreement))
  cq_note("CQTC_QT_CHANGE_DISAGREEMENT ", sum(qt_disagreement), " paired records exceed 0.11 ms. Source: ", QT_CHANGE_SOURCE, ".\n")
if (QT_CHANGE_SOURCE == "derived") {
  if (!any(qt_paired)) stop("CQTC_QT_CHANGE_DERIVED requires paired QTcF and baseline values")
  qtc_df$CFBQTCF <- ifelse(qt_paired, qt_derived, NA_real_)
}
qt_change_description <- paste0(
  if (QT_CHANGE_SOURCE == "derived")
    "Change from baseline was calculated from paired QTcF and baseline values in memory."
  else "Change from baseline was taken from the supplied dataset.",
  if (any(qt_disagreement))
    paste0(" In ", sum(qt_disagreement), " paired records, the supplied and calculated changes differed by more than 0.11 ms.")
  else "")

qtc_df <- qtc_df %>%
  mutate(DOSE = ifelse(is.na(TRTA), "All patients", dose_of(TRTA)),
         REGIMEN = regimen_of(TRTA))
cq_note("CQTC_SCHEMA_REGIMENS", paste(unique(qtc_df$DOSE), collapse = " | "), "\n")

qtc_tox <- qtc_df

if (!nzchar(STUDY_ID) && any(!is.na(qtc_tox$STUDYID)))
  STUDY_ID <- as.character(stats::na.omit(qtc_tox$STUDYID))[1]
if (!nzchar(STUDY_ID)) {
  STUDY_ID <- "(study)"
  cq_note("CQTC_SCHEMA_SKIP no STUDYID column — the report says '(study)'\n")
}
if (!nzchar(DRUG)) DRUG <- "drug"
if (!nzchar(INDICATION)) { INDICATION <- "the study indication"
  cq_note("CQTC_SCHEMA_SKIP no indication column — the report says 'the study indication'\n") }
if (!nzchar(MATRIX)) MATRIX <- "the study matrix"
if (!nzchar(LAB))    LAB    <- "the bioanalytical laboratory"

dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
labels <- data.frame(
  key   = c("STUDY", "PROJECT", "DRUG", "INDICATION", "ANALYTE", "MATRIX", "LAB",
            "DATASET", "AUTHOR", "DATE"),
  value = c(STUDY_ID, STUDY_ID, DRUG, INDICATION, ANALYTE, MATRIX, LAB,
            cq_file, AUTHOR, format(Sys.Date())),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(labels, file.path(OUT_DIR, "labels.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cq_note("CQTC_LABELS", paste(labels$key, labels$value, sep = "=", collapse = " "), "\n")

ATPT_ORDER <- c("PREDOSE", "PRE", "POST15M", "POST30M", "POST1H", "POST2H", "POST3H",
                "POST4H", "POST6H", "POST8H", "POST12H", "POST24H", "POST48H",
                "POST72H", "POST168H")
.cq_obs <- unique(as.character(qtc_tox$ATPT))
if (any(!is.na(qtc_tox$ATPTN))) {
  .cq_ord <- tapply(as.numeric(qtc_tox$ATPTN), as.character(qtc_tox$ATPT), min, na.rm = TRUE)
  ATPT_LEVELS <- names(.cq_ord)[order(unlist(.cq_ord))]
} else {
  ATPT_LEVELS <- c(intersect(ATPT_ORDER, .cq_obs), setdiff(.cq_obs, ATPT_ORDER))
}
cq_note("CQTC_SCHEMA_ATPT", paste(ATPT_LEVELS, collapse = " | "), "\n")

# One disposition cohort is used by screening, fitting and diagnostics.
blq_flag <- function(x) {
  value <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  yes <- c("Y","YES","TRUE","T","1"); no <- c("N","NO","FALSE","F","0","")
  bad <- !is.na(value) & !value %in% c(yes,no)
  if(any(bad)) stop("Unrecognised PKBLQ coding; configure BLQ coding explicitly")
  !is.na(value) & value %in% yes
}
d0 <- qtc_tox
d1 <- d0[!blq_flag(d0$PKBLQ),,drop=FALSE]
d2 <- d1[!is.na(d1$PKCONC),,drop=FALSE]
d3 <- if(HAVE_BQTCF) d2[!is.na(d2$BQTCF),,drop=FALSE] else d2
d4 <- d3[!is.na(d3$CFBQTCF),,drop=FALSE]
qtc_tox2 <- d4 %>%
  mutate(AGE = AGE - stat_func(d4, AGE, median),
         ATPT = factor(as.character(ATPT),levels=ATPT_LEVELS), CYCLE=cycle_of(AVISIT))
if(HAVE_BQTCF) qtc_tox2 <- qtc_tox2 %>% mutate(BQTCF=BQTCF-stat_func(d4,BQTCF,median))

if (!HAVE_TSFD) {
  if (!all(is.na(qtc_tox2$ADY))) {
    qtc_tox2$TSFD <- as.numeric(qtc_tox2$ADY) * 24
    HAVE_TSFD <- TRUE
    cq_note("CQTC_SCHEMA_TSFD derived from ADY (hours)\n")
  } else {
    qtc_tox2$TSFD <- NA_real_
    cq_note("CQTC_SCHEMA_SKIP no TSFD and no ADY — the hysteresis section is omitted\n")
  }
}
HAVE_TUMTP <- HAVE_TUMTP && any(!is.na(qtc_tox2$TUMTP))
```

```{r plot-visit-summary-func, include=FALSE}
plot_visit_summary <- function(data,
                               value,
                               ylab,
                               group_var = NULL,
                               facet_var = "CYCLE",
                               hline0 = FALSE,
                               dodge_width = 0.4,
                               facet_nrow = NULL) {

  value <- enquo(value)

  grp1 <- c("USUBJID", "ATPT")
  if (!is.null(group_var)) grp1 <- c(group_var, grp1)
  if (!is.null(facet_var)) grp1 <- c(facet_var, grp1)

  grp2 <- "ATPT"
  if (!is.null(group_var)) grp2 <- c(group_var, grp2)
  if (!is.null(facet_var)) grp2 <- c(facet_var, grp2)

  plotdat <- data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(ATPT),
      !is.na(!!value),
      toupper(as.character(AVISIT)) != "BASELINE"
    ) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(grp1))) %>%
    summarize(
      VALUE = max(!!value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(grp2))) %>%
    summarize(
      N = sum(!is.na(VALUE)),
      Mean = mean(VALUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(VALUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      SE = SD / sqrt(N),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  dodge <- position_dodge(width = dodge_width)

  if (is.null(group_var)) {

    p <- ggplot(
      plotdat,
      aes(
        x = ATPT,
        y = Mean
      )
    ) +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_errorbar(
        aes(
          ymin = Mean - SE,
          ymax = Mean + SE
        ),
        width = 0.15
      )

  } else {

    p <- ggplot(
      plotdat,
      aes(
        x = ATPT,
        y = Mean,
        color = .data[[group_var]]
      )
    ) +
      geom_point(
        size = 2,
        position = dodge
      ) +
      geom_errorbar(
        aes(
          ymin = Mean - SE,
          ymax = Mean + SE
        ),
        width = 0.15,
        position = dodge
      )
  }

  if (hline0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = 0,
        linetype = 2
      )
  }

  if (!is.null(facet_var)) {
    p <- p +
      facet_wrap(
        as.formula(paste("~", facet_var)),
        nrow = facet_nrow
      )
  }

  p +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = ylab,
      color = group_var
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1
      ),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```

### 4.2.2. Base Model

```{r base-model, results="asis"}
lmer_fixest <- function(fit) {
  # lm-aware: cq_fit() can fall back to fixed effects only (no random effects).
  fe <- if (inherits(fit, "merMod")) lme4::fixef(fit) else stats::coef(fit)
  se <- summary(fit)$coefficients[, "Std. Error"]
  ci_lb <- fe - 1.96 * se
  ci_ub <- fe + 1.96 * se

  output <- data.frame(
    EST = fe,
    SE = se,
    CI_LB = ci_lb,
    CI_UB = ci_ub) %>%
    mutate(BIC = round(BIC(fit), 1))
  return(output)
}

lmer_rdmest <- function(fit) {
  if (!inherits(fit, "merMod"))
    return(data.frame(Parameters = "Residual", SD = round(summary(fit)$sigma, 3)))
  data.frame(VarCorr(fit)) %>%
    mutate(var1 = ifelse(var1 == "(Intercept)", "Intercept", var1)) %>%
    mutate(var2 = ifelse(is.na(var2), "", var2)) %>%
    mutate(Parameters = ifelse(grp == "Residual", grp, paste0(var1, "  ", var2))) %>%
    mutate(SD = round(sdcor, 3)) %>%
    dplyr::select(Parameters, SD)
}

cq_variables <- function(tab,vars,d,fit) {
  terms <- rownames(tab)
  labelled <- add_cat_labels(tab,vars,d,fit=fit)
  vapply(seq_along(terms),function(i) {
    term <- terms[i]
    hit <- vars[vapply(vars,function(v) startsWith(term,v),TRUE)]
    comparison <- if("Comparison (N)" %in% names(labelled)) labelled[["Comparison (N)"]][i] else NA_character_
    if(length(hit) && !is.na(comparison) && nzchar(comparison)) {
      v <- hit[which.max(nchar(hit))]
      if(v %in% cov_categorical) return(paste0(cov_display(v),": ",comparison))
      return(comparison)
    }
    if(term=="(Intercept)") "Intercept" else if(term=="PKCONC") CONC_LAB else term
  },"")
}
cq_parameter_table <- function(fit,vars=character(),d=model.frame(fit)) {
  fe <- if(inherits(fit,"merMod")) lme4::fixef(fit) else stats::coef(fit)
  se <- summary(fit)$coefficients[,"Std. Error"]
  fmt <- function(x) ifelse(is.finite(x),formatC(x,digits=4,format="g"),"NE")
  fixed <- data.frame(term=names(fe),row.names=names(fe))
  out <- data.frame(Parameter=cq_variables(fixed,vars,d,fit),Component="Fixed effect",
    Estimate=fmt(fe),SE=fmt(se),`95% CI`=paste(fmt(fe-1.96*se),fmt(fe+1.96*se),sep=" to "),
    check.names=FALSE,row.names=NULL)
  if(inherits(fit,"merMod")) {
    vc <- as.data.frame(lme4::VarCorr(fit))
    correlation <- !is.na(vc$var2)
    parameter <- ifelse(vc$grp=="Residual","Residual",
      paste0(vc$grp,": ",vc$var1,ifelse(correlation,paste0(" / ",vc$var2),"")))
    component <- ifelse(vc$grp=="Residual","Residual SD",
      ifelse(correlation,"Random-effect correlation","Random-effect SD"))
    random <- data.frame(Parameter=parameter,Component=component,Estimate=fmt(vc$sdcor),
      SE="—",`95% CI`="—",check.names=FALSE)
  } else random <- data.frame(Parameter="Residual",Component="Residual SD",
    Estimate=fmt(summary(fit)$sigma),SE="—",`95% CI`="—",check.names=FALSE)
  out <- rbind(out,random)
  out$BIC <- "";out$BIC[1] <- formatC(BIC(fit),digits=1,format="f")
  out
}

# Base-model random-effects structure
BASE_COV <- intersect(mandatory_cov,names(qtc_tox2))
BASE_COV <- BASE_COV[vapply(BASE_COV,function(v) length(unique(na.omit(qtc_tox2[[v]])))>1L,TRUE)]
cq_screen_rhs <- paste(c("PKCONC", BASE_COV), collapse = " + ")
cq_re_choice <- cq_choose_re(cq_screen_rhs, qtc_tox2)
BASE_RE <- cq_re_choice$re
cq_note("CQTC_RE_STRUCTURE ", BASE_RE, " (chosen on ", cq_screen_rhs, ")\n")
base_fit <- cq_re_choice$fit
if(!fit_valid(base_fit)) stop("CQTC_BASE_FIT_UNUSABLE: no estimable prespecified base model")
attr(base_fit,"re_struct") <- BASE_RE

base_tab <- function(expr, cap) tryCatch(kable(expr, caption = cap, row.names=FALSE, align = "c"),
  error = function(e) { cq_note("CQTC_BASE_FIT_TABLE_UNAVAILABLE ", conditionMessage(e), "\n");
                        knitr::asis_output("_Not available for this dataset._") })
base_tab(cq_parameter_table(base_fit), "Base model parameter estimates")
cat("\nSE and 95% CI are provided for fixed effects. Random-effect and residual SD/correlation uncertainty was not computed; — does not mean zero. SD is not SE.\n")
```

### 4.2.3. Full Model

#### Covariate Analysis

```{r covariate-analysis, results="asis"}
cov_var <- cov_want[vapply(cov_want, function(x)
  x %in% names(qtc_tox2) && sum(!is.na(qtc_tox2[[x]])) >= 3 &&
    length(unique(stats::na.omit(qtc_tox2[[x]]))) >= 2, logical(1))]
cov_var <- setdiff(cov_var,mandatory_cov)
if (length(setdiff(setdiff(cov_want,mandatory_cov), cov_var)))
  cq_note("CQTC_SCHEMA_COV_DROP", paste(setdiff(setdiff(cov_want,mandatory_cov), cov_var), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cq_note("CQTC_SCHEMA_COV", paste(cov_var, collapse = " | "), "\n")
if(!length(cov_var)) cq_note("CQTC_NO_OPTIONAL_COVARIATES: full model equals the prespecified base model\n")

set_ref <- set_cat_ref(qtc_tox2, cov_var)
qtc_tox2 <- set_ref$data
if (length(set_ref$releveled))
  cq_note("CQTC_SCHEMA_REF_RELEVEL ",
          paste(sprintf("%s (was '%s')", names(set_ref$releveled), set_ref$releveled),
                collapse = " | "), "\n")

univ_model <- list(); univ_result <- list(); retained <- character(); failed_covariates <- character()
for(v in cov_var) {
  vars <- unique(c("CFBQTCF", "PKCONC", "USUBJID", BASE_COV, v))
  same <- qtc_tox2[complete.cases(qtc_tox2[,vars,drop=FALSE]),,drop=FALSE]
  same <- set_cat_ref(same,intersect(cov_categorical,v))$data
  pair_base <- tryCatch(cq_fit(cq_screen_rhs,same,re=BASE_RE),error=function(e) {cq_note("CQTC_CANDIDATE_UNUSABLE ",v,": ",conditionMessage(e),"\n");NULL})
  pair_full <- if(is.null(pair_base)) NULL else tryCatch(cq_fit(paste(c(cq_screen_rhs,v),collapse=" + "),same,re=attr(pair_base,"re_struct")),
    error=function(e) {cq_note("CQTC_CANDIDATE_UNUSABLE ",v,": ",conditionMessage(e),"\n");NULL})
  if(!is.null(pair_full) && !identical(attr(pair_base,"re_struct"),attr(pair_full,"re_struct"))) {
    re <- attr(pair_full,"re_struct")
    pair_base <- cq_fit_at(re,cq_screen_rhs,same)
    if(!is.null(pair_base)) attr(pair_base,"re_struct") <- re
  }
  if(!fit_valid(pair_full) || !fit_valid(pair_base)) {failed_covariates <- union(failed_covariates,v);cq_note("CQTC_CANDIDATE_UNUSABLE ",v,"\n"); next}
  if(nobs(pair_base)!=nobs(pair_full)) {failed_covariates <- union(failed_covariates,v);cq_note("CQTC_CANDIDATE_SAMPLE_MISMATCH ",v,"\n"); next}
  tab <- lmer_fixest(pair_full); extra <- setdiff(rownames(tab),rownames(lmer_fixest(pair_base)))
  tab <- tab[extra,,drop=FALSE]; if(!nrow(tab)) {failed_covariates <- union(failed_covariates,v);next}
  delta <- BIC(pair_full)-BIC(pair_base)
  tab$DELTA <- round(delta,1); tab$sig <- if(delta<0) "Yes" else "No"
  tab$Covariate <- v; tab$N_records <- nrow(model.frame(pair_full)); tab$N_subjects <- length(unique(same$USUBJID))
  tab <- add_cat_labels(tab,v,same,fit=pair_full)
  tab$Variables <- cq_variables(tab,v,same,pair_full)
  univ_result[[v]] <- tab; univ_model[[v]] <- pair_full
  if(delta<0) retained <- c(retained,v)
}
if(length(univ_result)) {
  univ_output <- bind_rows(univ_result) %>% arrange(desc(sig=="Yes"),DELTA,BIC,Covariate)
} else univ_output <- data.frame(Covariate=character(),DELTA=numeric(),sig=character())

rows <- list(); prefixes <- character()
display_vars <- unique(univ_output$Covariate)
display_vars <- c(setdiff(display_vars,cov_categorical),intersect(display_vars,cov_categorical))
for(v in display_vars) {
  group <- univ_output[univ_output$Covariate==v,,drop=FALSE]
  label <- cov_display(v); categorical <- v %in% cov_categorical
  if(categorical) {
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- data.frame(Covariate=label,Estimate="",`95% CI`="",
      BIC=formatC(group$BIC[1],digits=1,format="f"),`Delta BIC`=formatC(group$DELTA[1],digits=1,format="f"),
      Retained=group$sig[1],check.names=FALSE)
    prefixes <- c(prefixes,label)
  }
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(group))) {
    comparison <- sub("\\s*\\(N\\s*=.*\\)\\s*$","",group[["Comparison (N)"]][i],perl=TRUE)
    rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- data.frame(Covariate=if(categorical) paste0("\u00a0",comparison) else label,
      Estimate=cq_format_coef(group$EST[i]),`95% CI`=paste(cq_format_coef(group$CI_LB[i]),cq_format_coef(group$CI_UB[i]),sep=" to "),
      BIC=if(categorical) "" else formatC(group$BIC[i],digits=1,format="f"),
      `Delta BIC`=if(categorical) "" else formatC(group$DELTA[i],digits=1,format="f"),
      Retained=if(categorical) "" else group$sig[i],check.names=FALSE)
    prefixes <- c(prefixes,if(categorical) "" else label)
  }
}
univ_display <- if(length(rows)) do.call(rbind,rows) else data.frame(Covariate=character(),Estimate=character(),`95% CI`=character(),BIC=character(),`Delta BIC`=character(),Retained=character(),check.names=FALSE)
attr(univ_display,"bold_labels") <- prefixes
cq_kable(univ_display,caption="Covariate analysis",
      align=paste0("l",strrep("c",ncol(univ_display)-1)),table.attr='class="table covariate-screen"')
if(length(failed_covariates)) cat("\n\nCovariate assessment was incomplete: ",paste(failed_covariates,collapse=", ")," could not be evaluated; failure is not evidence of no effect.\n\n",sep="")
```

#### Full Model Parameter Estimates

```{r full-model}
FULL_COV <- unique(c(BASE_COV,retained))
FULL_COV <- unique(c(BASE_COV,setdiff(FULL_COV,BASE_COV)[vapply(setdiff(FULL_COV,BASE_COV),
  function(v) length(unique(na.omit(qtc_tox2[[v]])))>1L,TRUE)]))
if(!length(FULL_COV)) FULL_COV <- NULL
FULL_LAB <- if (is.null(FULL_COV)) {
  "CFBQTCF ~ PKCONC (no estimable baseline adjustment or optional covariate)"
} else {
  paste("CFBQTCF ~ PKCONC +",paste(FULL_COV,collapse=" + "))
}
full_vars <- unique(c("CFBQTCF","PKCONC","USUBJID",FULL_COV))
full_data <- qtc_tox2[complete.cases(qtc_tox2[,full_vars,drop=FALSE]),,drop=FALSE]
full_data <- set_cat_ref(full_data,intersect(FULL_COV,cov_categorical))$data
base_comparison_fit <- if(identical(rownames(model.frame(base_fit)),rownames(full_data))) base_fit else
  cq_fit(cq_screen_rhs, full_data, re = BASE_RE)
full_re <- attr(base_comparison_fit, "re_struct")
full_fit <- if (!length(retained)) base_comparison_fit else
  cq_fit(paste(c("PKCONC", FULL_COV), collapse = " + "), full_data, re = full_re)
if(!is.null(full_fit) && !identical(attr(base_comparison_fit,"re_struct"),attr(full_fit,"re_struct"))) {
  re <- attr(full_fit,"re_struct")
  base_comparison_fit <- cq_fit_at(re,cq_screen_rhs,full_data)
  if(!fit_valid(base_comparison_fit)) stop("CQTC_BASE_COMPARISON_UNUSABLE: cannot compare full and base with the same random-effects structure")
  attr(base_comparison_fit,"re_struct") <- re
}

kable(cq_parameter_table(full_fit,unique(c(cov_var,FULL_COV)),full_data),
      caption="Full model parameter estimates",row.names=FALSE,align="c")
check_cat_ref(full_data,unique(c(cov_var,FULL_COV)),fit=full_fit)
```

### 4.2.4. Diagnostics

```{r final-model, fig.width=8.5, fig.height=4, fig.cap="Observed versus population and individual predictions of change in QTcF"}
final_fit <- full_fit
if(!fit_valid(final_fit)) stop("CQTC_FINAL_FIT_UNUSABLE: cannot report an unclean final fit or change structure after comparison tables")
qtc_tox2 <- full_data

qtc_predict <- function(fit,newdata=NULL,individual=FALSE) {
  d <- if(is.null(newdata)) model.frame(fit) else newdata
  if (inherits(fit, "merMod")) {
    fixed <- lme4::nobars(formula(fit)); tt <- delete.response(terms(fixed))
    mm <- model.matrix(tt,data=d,contrasts.arg=attr(lme4::getME(fit,"X"),"contrasts"))
    beta <- lme4::fixef(fit); mm <- mm[,names(beta),drop=FALSE]
    mu <- if(individual) predict(fit,newdata=d,re.form=NULL) else as.numeric(mm %*% beta)
  } else {
    fixed <- formula(fit); tt <- delete.response(terms(fixed))
    beta <- stats::coef(fit)
    mm <- model.matrix(tt,data=d); mm <- mm[,names(beta),drop=FALSE]
    mu <- as.numeric(mm %*% beta)
  }
  data.frame(fit=mu,se.fit=sqrt(pmax(0,rowSums((mm %*% as.matrix(vcov(fit)))*mm))))
}
final_pred <- qtc_predict(final_fit) %>%
  cbind(qtc_tox2)

final_ipred <- qtc_predict(final_fit,individual=TRUE) %>%
  cbind(qtc_tox2)

pred_plot <- ggplot(final_pred, aes(fit, CFBQTCF)) +
  geom_point(shape = 1, color = "blue") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.95) +
  labs(x = expression("Population predicted "*Delta*"QTcF (ms)"),
       y = expression("Observed "*Delta*"QTcF (ms)"))

ipred_plot <- ggplot(final_ipred, aes(fit, CFBQTCF)) +
  geom_point(shape = 1, color = "blue") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.95) +
  labs(x = expression("Individual predicted "*Delta*"QTcF (ms)"),
       y = expression("Observed "*Delta*"QTcF (ms)"))

grid.arrange(pred_plot, ipred_plot, nrow = 1)
```

### 4.2.5. Simulations

#### Simulation vs Observation

```{r sim-vs-obs, fig.width=7, fig.height=5, fig.cap="Model-predicted and observed change in QTcF versus concentration"}
qtc_reference_frame <- function(grid) {
  for(v in FULL_COV) {
    x <- full_data[[v]]
    if(is.factor(x)) grid[[v]] <- factor(rep(levels(x)[1],nrow(grid)),levels=levels(x))
    else grid[[v]] <- median(x,na.rm=TRUE)
  }
  grid
}
sim_data <- data.frame(PKCONC = seq(min(qtc_tox2$PKCONC), max(qtc_tox2$PKCONC), length.out=101L)) %>%
  mutate(BQTCF = 0)
sim_data <- qtc_reference_frame(sim_data)
sim_pred <- qtc_predict(final_fit,sim_data) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  cbind(sim_data) %>%
  mutate(fit_lb = fit - 1.96 * se.fit,
         fit_ub = fit + 1.96 * se.fit)
prediction_range <- list(
  confidence_level=0.95,
  reference_ms=10,
  observed_concentration_range=range(sim_pred$PKCONC),
  endpoints=sim_pred[c(1L,nrow(sim_pred)),c("PKCONC","fit","fit_lb","fit_ub")],
  max_mean_ms=max(sim_pred$fit),
  max_upper_ms=max(sim_pred$fit_ub)
)

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = qtc_tox2, aes(x = PKCONC, y = CFBQTCF), color = "blue", shape = 1) +
  geom_line(data = sim_pred, aes(x = PKCONC, y = fit)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = sim_pred, aes(x = PKCONC, ymin = fit_lb, ymax = fit_ub), alpha = 0.2, fill = "blue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 10, linetype = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-30, 20, by = 10)) +
  labs(x = CONC_LAB,
       y = expression(Delta*"QTcF (ms)"))
```

#### ΔQTcF versus Concentration — Binned Means

```{r conc-qtc-bins, fig.width=7, fig.height=5, fig.cap="Change in QTcF versus concentration by concentration bin"}
qtc_bins <- qtc_tox2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(PKCONC), !is.na(CFBQTCF)) %>%
  mutate(BIN = dplyr::ntile(PKCONC, 10)) %>%
  group_by(BIN) %>%
  summarise(CONC = mean(PKCONC), N = dplyr::n(),
            MEAN = mean(CFBQTCF), SE = sd(CFBQTCF) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(LB = MEAN - 1.645 * SE, UB = MEAN + 1.645 * SE)   # 90% CI

bins_grid <- data.frame(PKCONC = seq(min(qtc_bins$CONC), max(qtc_bins$CONC),
                                     length.out = 100), BQTCF = 0)
bins_grid <- qtc_reference_frame(bins_grid)
bins_line <- qtc_predict(final_fit,bins_grid)
bins_grid$FIT <- bins_line$fit
bins_grid$LB  <- bins_line$fit - 1.645 * bins_line$se.fit
bins_grid$UB  <- bins_line$fit + 1.645 * bins_line$se.fit

ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = bins_grid, aes(PKCONC, ymin = LB, ymax = UB),
              alpha = 0.2, fill = "blue") +
  geom_line(data = bins_grid, aes(PKCONC, FIT), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(data = qtc_bins, aes(CONC, ymin = LB, ymax = UB), width = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = qtc_bins, aes(CONC, MEAN), size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(data = qtc_bins, aes(CONC, MEAN, label = paste0("n=", N)),
            vjust = -1.1, size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 10, linetype = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 3, colour = "grey40") +
  labs(x = CONC_LAB,
       y = expression("Mean "*Delta*"QTcF (ms) with 90% CI"))
```

#### Hysteresis of ΔQTcF versus Concentration

```{r hysteresis, fig.width=10, fig.height=if(HYSTERESIS_VIEW=="individual") 8 else 4.5, fig.cap="Hysteresis of change in QTcF versus concentration"}
hyst <- qtc_tox2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(TSFD),TSFD <= 21*24,!is.na(PKCONC),!is.na(CFBQTCF)) %>%
  arrange(USUBJID,TSFD) %>% group_by(USUBJID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(TSFD)>1) %>% ungroup()
hysteresis_shown <- nrow(hyst)>0
if(!HYSTERESIS_VIEW %in% c("individual","overview")) stop("HYSTERESIS_VIEW must be individual or overview")
if(length(HYSTERESIS_PANELS)!=1 || !is.finite(HYSTERESIS_PANELS) || HYSTERESIS_PANELS!=floor(HYSTERESIS_PANELS) || HYSTERESIS_PANELS<1 || HYSTERESIS_PANELS>12)
  stop("HYSTERESIS_PANELS must be an integer from 1 to 12")
HYSTERESIS_PANELS <- as.integer(HYSTERESIS_PANELS)
if(hysteresis_shown) {
  ids <- unique(as.character(hyst$USUBJID))
  groups <- if(HYSTERESIS_VIEW=="overview") list(ids) else split(ids,ceiling(seq_along(ids)/HYSTERESIS_PANELS))
  for(ids_here in groups) {
    shown <- hyst[hyst$USUBJID %in% ids_here,,drop=FALSE]
    shown$Patient <- paste0(shown$USUBJID,"; ",shown$DOSE)
    p <- ggplot(shown,aes(PKCONC,CFBQTCF,group=USUBJID,colour=TSFD)) +
      geom_path(alpha=0.7,linewidth=0.35,arrow=grid::arrow(length=grid::unit(.06,"inches"),type="closed")) +
      geom_point(size=.8,alpha=.7) + scale_colour_viridis_c(name="Hours since\nfirst dose") +
      geom_hline(yintercept=0,linetype=3,colour="grey40") + geom_hline(yintercept=10,linetype=2) +
      labs(x=CONC_LAB,y=expression(Delta*"QTcF (ms)"),
           caption="Arrows indicate increasing time; these exploratory trajectories do not establish the absence of hysteresis.") +
      theme_bw(base_size=12) + theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank())
    if(HYSTERESIS_VIEW=="individual") p <- p + facet_wrap(~Patient,ncol=3,labeller=label_wrap_gen(width=25))
    else p <- p + facet_wrap(~DOSE,nrow=1)
    print(p)
  }
} else cq_note("CQTC_SCHEMA_SKIP hysteresis: no patient has usable records at multiple times\n")
```

#### Goodness of Fit and Model Statistics

```{r model-stats, results="asis"}
slope_row <- function(fit, label) {
  fe <- if (inherits(fit, "merMod")) lme4::fixef(fit) else stats::coef(fit)
  se <- summary(fit)$coefficients[, "Std. Error"]
  sl <- fe[["PKCONC"]]; slse <- se[["PKCONC"]]
  data.frame(
    Model = label,
    Intercept = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", fe[["(Intercept)"]], se[["(Intercept)"]]),
    Slope = sprintf("%.4f (%.4f)", sl, slse),
    CI90 = sprintf("%.4f to %.4f", sl - 1.645 * slse, sl + 1.645 * slse),
    pval = format.pval(2 * pnorm(-abs(sl / slse)), digits = 3, eps = 1e-4),
    BIC = sprintf("%.1f", BIC(fit)),
    check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
model_stats <- rbind(slope_row(base_comparison_fit, "Base model"),
                     slope_row(full_fit, "Full model"))
names(model_stats) <- c("Model", "Intercept (SE)", "Slope (SE)", "Slope 90% CI",
                        "p (slope, Wald z)", "BIC")
kable(model_stats, align = "lccccc",
      caption = "Concentration-QTcF relationship and goodness of fit")
cat(paste0("\nSlope and its uncertainty are expressed in ",SLOPE_UNIT,".\n"))
```
